physicalDevice.note: No physical Android device was attached at any point in this lane (adb devices -l empty). Amendment D2's mandatory physical-device screenshot is OUTSTANDING.

emulator.note: Secondary authority. Visual capture additionally blocked by the app's own auth routing guard, which was deliberately not weakened to obtain a screenshot.

apk.note: An x86_64+arm64-v8a APK (sha256 79d224a6e21b328dfaa71cf233b44999a3d6c31f4efe9d255b92b2b0ae2dde7c, 207372047 bytes) was also produced from 171739e and is the physical-device-installable artifact; the emulator could not fit it (INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE, /data 88% full), so the x86_64-only variant was used for emulator evidence.

n1d_replay_on_device.interpretation: The diagnostic view never reached the screen (the auth routing guard redirected away), so onDraw never consumed a snapshot. The native replay clock nevertheless ran the whole 121-frame source to EOF at its own cadence (121 x 33ms = 3.99s expected vs 4.32s measured). produced=121 with rendered=0 and slot depth bounded at 1 is the strongest available on-device demonstration that production is independent of render and that the latest-state slot drops rather than queues: the renderer was entirely absent and the producer neither stalled nor accumulated a backlog.
